rv.q: 4/5 Stars! The Irish writer-performer Mary Kate O Flanagan calls storytelling her religion, and her life-affirming solo performance Making a Show of Myself is sure to win her some acolytes.
But this performer is unusually winning, and she sends the crowd out on notes of positivity and regard for our fellow humans.
No matter, many people will be positively glad to make Flanagan’s big-hearted acquaintance.
The performance was deeply engaging, philosophically stimulating, and absolutely wondrous.
Although O Flanagan professes that “stories begin when things go wrong,” in this case, her stories make for very good theater.
